commits.message: A Markdown's parsed tree cannot be changed after it is read: token children are readonly (rich-unfiled-791c.y1ta)

Markdown parses its source once, when it is made, as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.y1ta)

The parse moves to src/renderables/markdown-parse.ts: the block pass, then
an inline pass reading each block's text into a tree of inlines, as
markdown-it makes its two passes. Nothing in it reads a RenderOptions, so
the constructor runs it and render only walks the tokens — a Live redrawing
a Markdown every frame no longer pays the whole parse, the quadratic inline
HTML scan included, once a frame.

test/renderables/markdown-parse-once.test.ts counts parseMarkdown calls
across a construction and three renders at two widths; making render parse
again fails it.

Markdown draws a character reference as the characters it names, as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.krtk) (#427)

* Markdown draws a character reference as the characters it names, as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.krtk)

Inline text decodes named, decimal and hex references by markdown-it's entity
rule, an invalid numeric one as U+FFFD; a link's destination goes through
markdown-it's unescapeAll before its href is made, so [a](javascript:x)
is refused as Rich refuses it. The named table is HTML5's, generated from
Python's html.entities.html5 by scripts/html-entities.py.

* docs: say how a numeric reference reads in text and in a URL; name DEL among the refused codes (rich-unfiled-791c.krtk)
